item.description: Two Hasbro shareholders who brought a lawsuit against company executives for alleged overprinting of Magic: The Gathering cards have voluntarily dismissed their case less than a month after the initial filing. item.title: U.S. consumer confidence improves modestly in February after cratering the first month of 2026
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) – The American consumer’s confidence in the U.S. economy improved slightly in February after cratering a month earlier. The Conference Board said Tuesday that its consumer confidence index rose to 91.2 in February from an upwardly revised 89 last month. A measure of Americans’ short-term expectations for their income, business conditions and the job market rose […]

item.title: Thousands of R.I. residents remain without power Tuesday
item.description: PROVIDENCE – Thousands of Rhode Island Energy customers are still without power Tuesday after a historic blizzard on Monday dropped record amounts of snow across the state accompanied by high winds. item.title: Report: Salve student found dead during snowstorm

item.title: McKee still trails Foulkes in R.I. governor race in latest UNH poll
item.description: PROVIDENCE – Gov. Daniel J. McKee’s reelection campaign is still struggling, according to the latest University of New Hampshire Ocean State Poll released Tuesday. According to the poll, which surveyed 703 Rhode Island residents from Feb. 12-16, Helena Foulkes holds a 16-point lead over the incumbent McKee. In November, Foulkes was up by 18 points. […]

item.title: Newport Historical Society exhibit explores city’s role during the American Revolution
item.description: NEWPORT – The Newport Historical Society debuted its new America250 exhibition, “OCCUPIED! Newport and the Fight for Independence” last week.
